newsitem.title: USA: Fed's Yellen under consideration for CEA chair.
newsitem.headline: Fed's Yellen under consideration for CEA chair.

text.p: Federal Reserve Governor Janet Yellen is under consideration to serve as chair of the Council of Economic Advisers (CEA), an administration source said on Wednesday.
The source, who asked not to be named, declined to comment on the chances of her being chosen to replace Joseph Stiglitz, who is leaving the CEA to become World Bank chief economist.

Last week Princeton economics professor Alan Blinder, a former Federal Reserve vice chairman and CEA member, said he had turned down an offer to return as chairman of CEA, which performs econonic analysis for the president.
